newsitem.title: USA: U.S., Florida orange crop estimates--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S., Florida orange crop estimates--USDA.

text.p: USDA orange production estimates (crop in 1,000 boxes, yield in gallons/box at 42.0 degrees Brix basis):
Note-U.S. oranges and Florida oranges exclude temples.

Florida orange production remained forecast for a record 220.0 million boxes despite freeze damage January 19. USDA raised the estimate of early and mid-season oranges to a record 133.0 million boxes, up three million from one month ago.
The Valencia forecast was reduced by three million boxes, or three percent, to total 87.0 million boxes.

A special freeze damage survey of the Valencia crop on February 3-4 showed 88 percent of the crop with no damage, and five percent with serious damage. The freeze will increase fruit droppage and juice losses. Valencia FCOJ yields were forecast for 1.60 gallons per box, compared to 1.62 a month ago.
